command:
set -eu
cat > /home/nodeapp/.config/systemd/user/node-hello.service <<'ANTRIEB_SERVICE'
[Unit]
Description=Rootless Podman Node.js hello-world service
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/podman run --rm --replace --name node-hello --publish 8080:8080 localhost/node-hello:latest
ExecStop=/usr/bin/podman stop --ignore --time 10 node-hello
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
TimeoutStopSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
ANTRIEB_SERVICE
chown nodeapp:nodeapp /home/nodeapp/.config/systemd/user/node-hello.service
restorecon -F /home/nodeapp/.config/systemd/user/node-hello.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
uid=$(id -u nodeapp)
loginctl enable-linger nodeapp
systemctl start "user@${uid}.service"
runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/${uid}" DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=/run/user/${uid}/bus" systemctl --user daemon-reload
runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/${uid}" DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=/run/user/${uid}/bus" systemctl --user enable --now node-hello.service
printf 'linger='; loginctl show-user nodeapp -p Linger --value
runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/${uid}" DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=/run/user/${uid}/bus" systemctl --user is-enabled node-hello.service
runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/${uid}" DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=/run/user/${uid}/bus" systemctl --user is-active node-hello.service
